newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-TOP BELGIAN COACHES PLAY MUSICAL CHAIRS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOP BELGIAN COACHES PLAY MUSICAL CHAIRS.

text.p: Belgium's leading first division soccer coaches have been playing musical chairs in recent weeks and the game was still continuing on Tuesday.
The Belgian soccer union started the carrousel by signing Georges Leekens of surprise leaders Mouscron as national coach with immediate effect.
Then Eric Gerets, coach of third-placed Lierse, agreed to move to second-placed Club Brugge, the title holders, at the end of this season and Brugge coach Hugo Broos decided to move to Mouscron.
On Tuesday Lierse announced Standard Liege coach Jos Daerden would be joining them and Belgium's other major side, Anderlecht, signed Rene Vandereycken, coach of rival Brussels team Molenbeek.
Standard Liege and Molenbeek have yet to announce replacement coaches.
